WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.title: Vengeance
WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.description:
Whenever Wandi loses HP, he gains 1 Vengeance.
Each stack of Vengeance increases his attack damage by 2%.
WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.smartDescriptio:
Whenever you lose HP, gain 1 Vengeance.
Each stack of Vengeance increases your attack damage by 2%.
WANDIMOD-STRIFE_POWER.title: Strife
WANDIMOD-STRIFE_POWER.description:
Wandi's temporary Max HP. Each stack of Strife grants +1 Max HP.
When combat ends, all Strife is lost and Max HP returns to normal.
WANDIMOD-STRIFE_POWER.smartDescription:
Temporary Max HP. Each stack grants +1 Max HP.
All Strife is lost when combat ends.
WANDIMOD-BERSERKER_HEART_POWER.title: Berserker Heart
WANDIMOD-BERSERKER_HEART_POWER.descripti: Whenever Wandi plays an Attack, he loses 1 HP and gains 1 Vengeance.
WANDIMOD-BERSERKER_HEART_POWER.smartDesc: Whenever you play an Attack, lose 1 HP and gain 1 Vengeance.
WANDIMOD-BLOODBURN_POWER.title: Bloodburn
WANDIMOD-BLOODBURN_POWER.description: Once per turn, when Wandi loses HP from his own card, he heals for the same amount.
WANDIMOD-BLOODBURN_POWER.smartDescriptio: Once per turn, when you lose HP from your own card, heal for the same amount.
WANDIMOD-BLOODTHIRST_FORM_POWER.title: Bloodthirst Form
WANDIMOD-BLOODTHIRST_FORM_POWER.descript: While Wandi's HP is at or below 50%, his attacks grant 1 Vengeance when they deal damage (limited times per turn).
WANDIMOD-BLOODTHIRST_FORM_POWER.smartDes: While your HP is at or below 50%, your attacks grant 1 Vengeance when they deal damage (limited times per turn).
WANDIMOD-GUARDIAN_PACT_POWER.title: Guardian Pact
WANDIMOD-GUARDIAN_PACT_POWER.description: This turn, allies take reduced damage, but Wandi takes 50% increased damage.
WANDIMOD-GUARDIAN_PACT_POWER.smartDescri: This turn, allies take reduced damage, but you take 50% increased damage.
WANDIMOD-INDOMITABLE_POWER.title: Indomitable
WANDIMOD-INDOMITABLE_POWER.description: At the end of combat, Wandi heals a percentage of his Max HP.
WANDIMOD-INDOMITABLE_POWER.smartDescript: At the end of combat, heal a percentage of your Max HP.
WANDIMOD-LASTING_FOCUS_POWER.title: Lasting Focus
WANDIMOD-SPIRIT_OF_KING_POWER.title: Spirit of King
WANDIMOD-SPIRIT_OF_KING_POWER.descriptio: Conquer all lands! deals 20% (25% upgraded) increased damage.
WANDIMOD-SPIRIT_OF_KING_POWER.smartDescr: Conquer all lands! deals increased damage.
WANDIMOD-FATAL_THRUST_POWER.title: Fatal Thrust
WANDIMOD-FATAL_THRUST_POWER.description: Temporarily reduces Strength. Restored at the end of the target's turn.
WANDIMOD-FATAL_THRUST_POWER.smartDescrip: Temporarily reduces Strength. Restored at the end of the turn.
